crossRefs.note: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.
His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.
His splendor is like the sunrise. Rays shine from his hand, where his power is hidden.
Plague went before him, and pestilence followed his feet.
He was changed before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.

parallels.note: At the brightness before him, coals of fire were kindled.

translations.web: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.
translations.bsb: From the brightness of His presence His clouds advanced— hailstones and coals of fire.
translations.kjv: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.
translations.asv: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, Hailstones and coals of fire.
